title: zanthoxylum rhoifolium var. suparanaense
intro: Zanthoxylum rhoifolium var. suparanaense, commonly known as the Suparanane or Wild Pepper, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae, native to Indonesia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in treating various conditions including fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum rhoifolium var. suparanaense include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
